safetyPolicy: Nothing in this manifest is malware and nothing here downloads malware. Part A pins historical malicious VERSIONS in lockfiles (text only — vexes flags them from OSV advisories, no package is fetched). Part B fixtures are techniques re-authored by us as inert source strings analyzed in-process. Part C downloads only well-known benign packages. No package code is ever executed in any part.
